tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List product categories
tools.description: List every chemical product category Global Chemicals LLC (gcoman.com) supplies. Returns category ids (URL slugs) and human-readable names.

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the Global Chemicals LLC product catalog (200+ industrial chemicals, lubricants, and lab equipment supplied in Oman/GCC) by keyword and optional category. Returns up to `limit` matches with title, category, short description, and canonical URL.

query.description: Free-text search string matched against product title, description, and CAS number.

category.description: Optional category id (see list_categories) to narrow the search, e.g. 'water-treatment'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50).

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product details
tools.description: Fetch the full details for a single product by its category slug and product slug (as used in the gcoman.com URL /products/<category>/<slug>). Returns title, description, CAS number, applications, and other structured product data.

tools.name: list_contact_submissions
tools.title: List recent contact submissions
tools.description: Admin only. Return the most recent contact-form submissions from gcoman.com (name, email, company, message, created_at). Requires the signed-in user to have the 'admin' role — non-admins receive an empty result under RLS.

tools.name: list_download_leads
tools.title: List recent download leads
tools.description: Admin only. Return the most recent PDF/brochure download leads captured on gcoman.com. Requires the signed-in user to have the 'admin' role — RLS returns no rows otherwise.
